feature_name: Specific multipart body limit error messages
description: When a multipart request exceeds the configured body size limit, return a specific error message 'Request payload is too large' instead of a generic parsing error. The status code should remain 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE as it already is.
functional_requirements: Update the multipart extractor to return 'Request payload is too large' when body size limit is exceeded
Maintain the existing 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE status code for these errors
Ensure the change applies to both the main axum crate and axum-extra crate's multipart implementations
Update existing tests to verify the specific error message is returned
